description.value: Queen India Jumbo Pizza is a family-owned restaurant in Langley Township that fuses bold Indian spices with Italian pizza traditions — think Butter Chicken Pizza and Paneer Pizza alongside creamy curries and freshly baked naan. The family has over 25 years in the food industry and makes their dough by hand daily from egg- and dairy-free ingredients. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, making it a flexible stop for hungry cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.
